You are also the expert operator on-site: you develop deep mastery of the system, operate it proficiently in the field, and train client teams toward full autonomy. Hardware Deployment: Install, assemble, connect, and bring up the system's physical components and equipment on site. Software Deployment: Install, configure, and parameterise the system's software for each operational context; comfortable on Linux. Commissioning: Bring the full system online and verify correct end-to-end functionality across hardware and software. Integration Support: Support connection of the company's systems with the client's existing operational environment, working alongside integration engineers. Test & Acceptance: Conduct on-site testing and acceptance activities through to client sign-off. Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and networking issues in the field; drive resolution and feed recurring findings back to engineering. System Expertise & Operation: Develop deep, hands-on mastery of the system; operate it proficiently in the field and serve as the on-site technical reference. Training & Enablement: Train and coach client operators and maintainers on system use, operation, and maintenance; build toward their autonomy; contribute to training and maintenance documentation. Networking fundamentals: connectivity setup and diagnostics. Comfortable on Linux; deploying, configuring, and debugging software in operational settings. Systems thinking: ability to reason across an integrated system of multiple subsystems, not a single component. Ability to master the system as an expert user and to teach it — strong communication and coaching skills, comfortable training client personnel. Hands-on maintenance and repair experience: preventive checks, fault diagnosis, corrective action, and return-to-service. Field temperament: autonomous in austere environments, procedurally rigorous, strong safety mindset in safety-critical operational settings. Comfortable with a high travel rate and extended on-site campaigns — this is core to the role. Proficiency in English is mandatory; additional languages relevant to the region of operations are a plus. Nice to Have Experience with complex hardware-software integrated systems.
